summary.zh: 计费透支：资金枚举追加 overdraft_draw 与 overdraft_receivable，付款主体新增每户透支上限列（默认 0，即不允许透支），资金投影新增两个触发器约束透支投影非负且不超过上限。不改已有数据，不动资金。
summary.en: Billing overdraft: appends overdraft_draw and overdraft_receivable to the funds enums, adds a per-payer overdraft limit column (default 0, no overdraft) and two projection triggers that keep the overdraft projection non-negative and within the limit. No existing data changes and no money moves.

verification.zh: 核对 PayerAccount 存在 overdraftLimitFen 且所有行为 0；FundsAccountProjection 有两个 overdraft 触发器。
verification.en: Check that PayerAccount has overdraftLimitFen with every row at 0, and FundsAccountProjection has the two overdraft triggers.

verification.zh: 核对 FundsTransaction.kind 的枚举以 overdraft_draw 结尾。
verification.en: Check that the FundsTransaction.kind enum ends with overdraft_draw.
